compaction.far_payload: Feature index only; footprint, pivot, bounds, foundation, and fallback height remain reproducible from the pinned context and recipe.
compaction.record_payload: Only represented geometry and Unity authoring inputs are serialized; stable identity, source bounds, pivot, unit scale, fallback provenance, and default lidar fields are derived or stored once.

height_input.fallback: Keep the serialized terrain-sampled base_y and the pinned context render height. Never infer a surveyed accuracy claim from the 4 m raster.

label: KBDU Aerial Scenery V1 footprint-preserving building spatial contract
limitations: OSM footprints and tag-derived fallback heights are reference-grade, not survey-grade.
The current 4 m lidar height raster has no surveyed vertical-error study and cannot satisfy the 10 percent height gate.
Small context buildings beyond 2 km intentionally remain orthophoto-only instead of becoming floating roof cards.
This offline contract does not establish Quest performance, visual acceptance, or certified fidelity.

material_contract.incremental_texture_reason: The selected HangarKit PBR atlas triplet is already present in the product dependency closure through AirportCoreHangarKitAtlas.mat.

source_and_license.derivative_source: Pinned KBDU Reconstruction V2 OpenStreetMap building footprints and serialized terrain foundations

spatial_contract.component_rule: Only represented footprint parts that intersect or touch may share a component; batching never fills the space between parts.
spatial_contract.component_storage_rule: Only multi-part components are serialized; every represented feature not listed is an implicit singleton component.
spatial_contract.far_rule: Ordinary buildings beyond 4 km and sub-threshold structures beyond the unconditional mid-shell radius have no mesh geometry; the orthophoto is authoritative there.
spatial_contract.foundation_rule: Every rendered tier keeps the terrain-sampled recipe base_y without lidar or LOD mutation.
spatial_contract.material_rule: Every shell uses deterministic plausible brick, concrete, corrugated-metal, worn-metal, dark-roof, or asphalt-roof cells from the already-resident AirportCore V4 HangarKit PBR atlas; the obsolete repeated-window context atlas is forbidden.
spatial_contract.mid_rule: Useful projected-size mid geometry uses a fixed closed shell; vertex-removal simplification preserves source X/Z bounds, simple topology, and +/-10 percent area.
spatial_contract.near_rule: Hero-core and near closed shells use the quantized source footprint byte-for-byte.
spatial_contract.pivot_rule: The source polygon centroid and bounds are recomputed exactly from the pinned quantized footprint; unit scale, base_y, selected height, and batch bounds are immutable because runtime scale-changing LODs are forbidden.
spatial_contract.roof_rule: Conservative four-corner residential footprints may use a bounded deterministic gable; all other footprints retain a closed flat roof at the same maximum height.
